capabilities: Diff Sync, File Recovery, and Git version history for the active file
Open a selected version in a modal rendered as markdown or plain text
Overwrite the current file with a chosen version
Switch between line-by-line and side-by-side diff views
Copy a Git commit hash by clicking it
extras: The README warns the plugin uses private APIs and may break at any time. Git diffs only work with the Obsidian Git plugin installed; Sync diffs require an Obsidian Sync subscription.
problem: Obsidian's Sync and File Recovery store file versions but provide no way to see a diff between them before restoring.

relations.evidence: For this to work, the Obsidian Git plugin needs to be installed.
I personally find the file recovery diffs better as they are less frequent

summary: Diff viewer that compares Sync, File Recovery, and Git version history for the active file and can restore a selected version.
